## Account Expansion Radar (Clay + Apollo → HubSpot)
Daily scan of HubSpot customers for funding, executive hiring spikes, new technology and headcount growth. Creates Expansion Signal custom-object records, rep tasks and an upsell-play handoff, and alerts Slack.

**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` routes every planned write to *Dry-Run Telemetry*.
**No direct email sending:** the upsell play is a company property your HubSpot workflow uses to enrol contacts.

Code nodes are generated from `src/` by `npm run build`; do not edit them in n8n.

nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Daily 06:00. Accounts are re-checked every RECHECK_DAYS, oldest first, up to MAX_ACCOUNTS_PER_RUN per run.

nodes.name: Load Configuration
nodes.notes: Validates settings (fail fast) and builds the company search.

nodes.name: HubSpot API: Search Customer Accounts
nodes.notes: Customer companies (lifecyclestage = TARGET_LIFECYCLE_STAGE), least recently checked first.

nodes.name: Prepare Accounts
nodes.notes: Normalizes domains, applies the re-check cadence and run cap.

nodes.name: Apollo Organization Enrich
nodes.notes: GET /api/v1/organizations/enrich?domain=… (consumes Apollo credits). Paced at under 1 request per second.

nodes.name: Plan Job Posting Lookup
nodes.notes: Builds the job-postings URL when Apollo returned an organization ID.

nodes.name: Apollo Job Postings
nodes.notes: GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/job_postings. Skipped lookups (null URL) fail locally and are ignored.

nodes.name: Score Apollo Signals
nodes.notes: Funding, executive hiring spikes, new technology and headcount growth → score and actions.

nodes.name: Build Clay Rows
nodes.notes: Returns nothing unless ENABLE_CLAY_PUSH=true and SANDBOX_MODE=false.

nodes.name: Clay Table Webhook
nodes.notes: Pushes each account into a Clay table (URL from CLAY_TABLE_WEBHOOK_URL). Clay enriches asynchronously.

nodes.name: Clay Signal Callback
nodes.notes: Clay HTTP API column posts results here with header x-radar-secret: RADAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Score Clay Signals
nodes.notes: Authenticates the callback, then scores Clay signals.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs planned records, tasks, updates and alerts.

nodes.name: Route Actions
nodes.notes: run_summary items match no rule and are dropped.

nodes.name: HubSpot Create Expansion Signal
nodes.notes: Custom object record. A unique signal_key makes re-runs idempotent (duplicates return 409 and are ignored).

nodes.name: HubSpot Create Task
nodes.notes: Expansion task for the account owner (or FALLBACK_OWNER_ID).

nodes.name: HubSpot Update Company
nodes.notes: Snapshot, score, last-checked and the expansion_radar_play handoff property.
